title: 第一卷 第11章 打上奴印第一卷 第12章 我要休息了
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 房间里弥漫起一股甜腻奇异的暗香，不断朝着曹阳身上钻，顺着他的七窍进入体内。
张娴雅仰起头，放肆地大笑出声。
胸前那一抹雪白随着笑声剧烈起伏，晃得人眼晕。
笑了好一会儿，才停了下来，居高临下地看着曹阳。
“你一个小小的废丹房杂役，能逼得我用出一张一阶二品清神符，足以自傲了。”
“还有这迷魂丹。”张娴雅揉着手腕，脸上的笑容却越来越盛，“可是我花重金从黑市淘来的，直接作用于经脉和神魂，别说你个炼气三层，就是炼气五层吸了，也会不省人事。”
“我不信你一个炼气三层的杂役能扛得住！”
曹阳眉头紧锁，呼吸也变得急促起来。
他确实感觉到一股阴寒的药力钻进经脉，灵力运转也开始变得滞涩。
四肢瘫软，精神恍惚，甚至连抬胳膊的力气都没有了。
“你这毒妇……”曹阳咬牙开口。
张娴雅冷哼一声，手指顺着曹阳的脸颊一路向下滑动，划过他的脖颈，停在他结实的胸膛上。
“真是一副好皮囊。”他用力捏了捏曹阳的肌肉，眼中异彩连连，“我就说你不对劲，每次看到你，你身上都会有所变化，之前的你可是要死了的人，现在却变成这副精壮的模样，你身上，肯定藏着大秘密！”
她俯下身子，饱满直接压在曹阳的胸膛上，红唇凑到曹阳耳边。
“不过没关系，只要彻底勾动噬魂引，你整个人都是我的，你的秘密也自然也是我的。”
张娴雅眼神一凝，双手飞快变换法诀。
“既然你现在成了废人，肯定没法再反制我了，乖乖当我的狗吧。”
一道法诀打完，张娴雅一个翻身。
噬魂引的秘法在这一刻被催动到了极致。
张娴雅闭上眼睛，脸上泛起潮红。
两人的灵魂在秘法的牵引下，开始强行交融。
她能清晰地感觉到，自己的一丝本源神魂正在一点点侵入曹阳的泥丸宫，要在那里打下奴役烙印。
“对，就是这样……”张娴雅越发疯狂了。
只要熬过这一刻，她就能拥有一个潜力无限又绝对忠诚的奴隶。
可就在进行到一炷香的时候，张娴雅猛地睁开眼睛。
不对劲！
曹阳中了迷魂丹之后，本来就该浑身无力地瘫着，但是现在，非但没有，反而感觉越来越好了！
张娴雅低头一看，只见曹阳脸上的虚弱早就消失得无影无踪，只剩下了那熟悉的冷笑！
曹阳对着她挑了挑眉，“夫人可真是个好人。”
真的是她主动送上门来的。
一开始自己还拒绝来着呢。
不过不得不说，迷魂丹确实厉害。
也让曹阳有了一阵子的虚弱。
但他有净元之体啊。
这可是连废丹房里那种能让人折寿的剧烈丹毒都能强行排出的体质。
迷魂丹的药效虽然猛烈，但在净元之体的运转下，刚才那一炷香的时间，早就被化解得干干净净了。
更让曹阳感到惊喜的是，他之前服用的是被阴阳造化鼎优化过的噬魂引，加上张娴雅毫无保留地催动噬魂引，强行将两人的灵魂连结在一起。
这灵魂交融的结果，不是张娴雅奴役他，反倒是他有了对张娴雅的一小部分控制权。
曹阳嘴角勾起，心念一动。
正处于震惊中的张娴雅，身体突然不受控制地做出了反应。
她猛地直起身子，对着曹阳妩媚一笑，紧接着，红唇微张，竟然不受控制地吐了吐舌头。
content_en:
The room was filled with a sweet and strange fragrance, which kept moving toward Cao Yang and entering his body along his seven orifices.
Zhang Xianya raised her head and laughed wildly.
The streak of snow-white on the chest rose and fell violently with laughter, making people dizzy.
After laughing for a while, he stopped and looked at Cao Yang condescendingly.
"You, a little helper in the alchemy room, can force me to use a first-level and second-level divine talisman. You are proud of yourself."
"And this Ecstasy Pill." Zhang Xianya rubbed her wrist, the smile on her face getting bigger and bigger, "But I spent a lot of money to buy it from the black market. It directly affects the meridians and soul. Not to mention you who are at the third level of Qi Refining, even if you are at the fifth level of Qi Refining, you will fall unconscious if you inhale it."
"I don't believe you, a handyman at the third level of Qi Refining, can handle it!"
Cao Yang frowned and his breathing became rapid.
He did feel a cold and cold medicinal power penetrate into his meridians, and the movement of his spiritual power began to become stagnant.
His limbs were limp and he was in a daze. He even had no strength to lift his arms.
"You poisonous woman..." Cao Yang gritted his teeth and said.
Zhang Xianya snorted coldly, and slid her fingers down Cao Yang's cheek, across his neck, and stopped on his strong chest.
"What a good skin." He squeezed Cao Yang's muscles hard, and his eyes were filled with sparkles. "I told you that there is something wrong with you. Every time I see you, you will change. You used to be a dying person, but now you have become this strong. There must be a big secret hidden in you!"
She leaned down, pressed her full body directly on Cao Yang's chest, and brought her red lips to Cao Yang's ear.
"But it doesn't matter. As long as you completely seduce Soul Devouring Yin, your whole body will be mine, and your secret will naturally be mine as well."
Zhang Xianya's eyes narrowed, and her hands quickly changed techniques.
"Since you are now a useless person, you will definitely not be able to resist me anymore. Just be my dog."
After finishing a spell, Zhang Xianya turned over.
The secret technique of Soul Devouring Yin was activated to the extreme at this moment.
Zhang Xianya closed her eyes and flushed on her face.
Under the pull of the secret method, the two souls began to forcibly merge.
She could clearly feel that a trace of her original soul was invading Cao Yang's Niwan Palace little by little, trying to leave a mark of slavery there.
"Yes, that's it..." Zhang Xianya became even more crazy.
As long as she survives this moment, she will have a slave with unlimited potential and absolute loyalty.
But just as she was about to burn a stick of incense, Zhang Xianya suddenly opened her eyes.
Something's wrong!
After Cao Yang was hit by the Ecstasy Pill, he should have been paralyzed with all his strength, but now, instead of not being there, he was actually feeling better and better!
Zhang Xianya lowered her head and saw that the weakness on Cao Yang's face had long since disappeared, leaving only the familiar sneer!
Cao Yang raised his eyebrows at her, "Madam, you are such a good person."
She really brought it to my door.
At first I refused.
But I have to say that the Ecstasy Pill is really powerful.
It also made Cao Yang weak for a while.
But he has a pure body.
This is a physique that can even forcibly expel the violent erysipelas in the waste elixir room that can shorten a person's life.
Although the effect of the Ecstasy Pill is strong, under the operation of the pure body, the time of burning the incense has been completely resolved long ago.
What surprised Cao Yang even more was that he had taken the Soul-eating Yin that had been optimized by the Yin-Yang Creation Cauldron, and Zhang Xianya activated the Soul-eating Yin without reservation, forcibly connecting the two souls together.
The result of this soul fusion was not that Zhang Xianya enslaved him, but that he had a small amount of control over Zhang Xianya.
Cao Yang raised the corners of his mouth and thought.
Zhang Xianya, who was in shock, suddenly reacted uncontrollably.
She straightened up suddenly and smiled charmingly at Cao Yang. Then, her red lips opened slightly and she stuck out her tongue uncontrollably.
